paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of articles across political leanings of the outlets
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across different political leanings of the news outlets, as indicated by the caption “Distribution of articles across political leanings of the outlets.” The chart contains four slices representing categories of political bias. The slice labeled “Right bias” is blue and comprises approximately 30.0% (30) of the total. “Left bias” is represented by an orange slice accounting for about 28.0% (28) of the pie. A green slice denotes “Questionable source” and makes up roughly 22.0% (22). Finally, “Left center bias” is shown as a red slice, representing approximately 20.0% (20) of the chart. The chart includes percentage labels and counts within each slice, as well as a legend identifying each category. The slices are arranged in an order descending by proportion, starting with “Right bias” and proceeding clockwise.
